info.description: Implemented MyoControl API. Cloud registries are read-only. General training belongs to a local workstation; live acquisition/calibration belongs to Electron. Legacy Data/ML/replay operations are private single-host development APIs. Examples are synthetic; passwords/tokens/UUIDs/digests shown here are not live credentials or measured results.
